text.card: KOI-5662 is a star of 3,449 K, bound to Kepler-504 431 AU away.
text.introduction: KOI-5662 shares its motion through space with Kepler-504, 431 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: KOI-5662's orbit around Kepler-504 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are

radialVelocity.source: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 2107186138825009152 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 30,000 of its distance per century
